messages:
maria: FYI rolling a small driver+CUDA canary to 5 nodes in eu-west-1 (dedicated h100 pool). Seeing IO stalls and KV-cache miss spikes from canary hosts, plus a couple tenant OOMs. I'm pausing the rollout.

deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated: https://deploys.redwood/in/1773123456 :rotating_light:

jonathan: details? which driver/CUDA versions? logs?

maria: driver 535.86 -> 536.12, CUDA 12.2 -> 12.3. nvidia-smi on one host shows high GPU memory usage and repeated MIG reset messages.

maria: dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 33, pid=2345, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.568000] nvidia: GPU 0: Xid 79
```

sasha: saw similar in us-west-2 last month with 12.3 on older kernel. Could be kernel driver mismatch with preempt timing. :eyes:

oliver: any NCCL/allreduce errors in logs? those cause big perf regressions.

maria: yes, NCCL timeouts on some pods, e.g. `NCCL WARN Call to connect failed` then `collective op timed out`.

jonathan: good call to pause. Recommend rollback to 535.86 + CUDA12.2 on canary hosts and run soak for 4h. Also set `routing.policy=avoid-canary` for dedicated tenants until fixed.

maria: rolling rollback now. Commands I'm running:
```
# drain node
redwood node drain r-eu-1-03
# revert driver
redwood infra update-driver --node r-eu-1-03 --driver 535.86 --cuda 12.2
```

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: https://deploys.redwood/rollbacks/98765

sasha: after rollback, please check KV cache hit rate and tail latency dashboards (Console > Dedicated > h100-eu-west1). I can run a quick synthetic workload.

maria: noted. Also adding kernel module pinning to the canary pool config to avoid auto-upgrades until we triage.

oliver: cost note — if we keep canary pool small but drained, dedicated tenants might spill to public pools and increase egress/cross-region cost. We should notify billing if this extends.

jonathan: let's create an incident if more than 2 hours. For now, set alert: `dedicated.h100.euw1.canary_io_stalls` severity=warning -> oncall.

maria: created ticket INFRA-2243 and linked logs. I'm going to collect full `nvidia-bug-report.sh` from affected hosts.

sasha: thanks. If it's kernel+driver timing, we may need a staged rollout: driver only on minor hosts first, kernel module build variation check, then gradually CUDA. Also run NCCL stress with varying allreduce sizes.

maria: agreed. I'll update the canary playbook at https://redwood.playbooks/dedicated-driver-canary with new rollback and soak thresholds.

oliver: :thumbsup: keep updates here. tagging @oncall

maria: will do — updating thread as nodes come back.
